# External Test Cases

Test cases extracted from open-source JSON repair libraries for cross-validation.

## Sources

- **josdejong/jsonrepair** (MIT) — https://github.com/josdejong/jsonrepair
- **mangiucugna/json_repair** (MIT) — https://github.com/mangiucugna/json_repair
- **RyanMarcus/dirty-json** (MIT) — https://github.com/RyanMarcus/dirty-json

## Files

- `extracted_cases.json` — 190 input/expected pairs extracted from all three libraries' test suites
- `build_cases.py` — extraction script (deduplicates, filters identity cases)
